# X-Wines test data

`XWines_Test_100_wines.csv` is the official 100-record test subset from the [X-Wines repository](https://github.com/rogerioxavier/X-Wines).

- License: [CC0 1.0 Universal](https://github.com/rogerioxavier/X-Wines/blob/main/LICENSE)
- Source file: [XWines_Test_100_wines.csv](https://github.com/rogerioxavier/X-Wines/blob/main/Dataset/last/XWines_Test_100_wines.csv)
- Required project citation: de Azambuja, R. X.; Morais, A. J.; Filipe, V. *X-Wines: A Wine Dataset for Recommender Systems and Machine Learning.* Big Data and Cognitive Computing 2023, 7, 20. https://doi.org/10.3390/bdcc7010020

The application uses this small subset only as an offline pairing-candidate source. It does not claim current price, vintage availability, inventory, or producer endorsement.
